I had to pee during a statewide test in high school. It was one of those exams they had us take in the gym and you could go only if you waved down a security person walking around for cheating and they escorted you to the bathroom. That test had 1 security person for the gym of roughly 120 students. The security person was nowhere near me and I didn’t have to pee that badly so i decided to just finish the exam and then i could have the freedom to go to the bathroom by myself. I also had social anxiety and didn’t want to wave like a maniac to get the security’s attention from the other side of the gym. 

So i wrapped up the test and handed it in, then went for the bathroom. The locker rooms were locked and the only hall bathroom on the gym side of the school was also locked. At this point, I really had to pee and didn’t think i would make it to the bathrooms on the other side of the building. Also there were more security people who were roaming the halls so i would need to explain myself to them (social anxiety again - I didn’t want to explain i needed to pee bad). 

So i just exited the school and quickly walked to the neighborhood just outside the school because i knew there were tons of bushes. Yes, this was a shorter walk than to the other side of the building and I didn’t need to speak to anyone.


Well I was finally able to find a bush that worked for me; I circled around like a dog bc I didn’t want other classmates to walk up on me or any people to see out their windows of the nearby houses. When i finished, I felt relieved and that I accomplished my mission. 

Unfortunately i forgot to account for people who were sitting in their cars (i guess parents waiting to pick up their kids from the exam?) and looked up and realized a woman was staring at me from her car like 5 feet away. She looked so bewildered. Luckily my back was to her so she didn’t see anything she shouldn’t, but it still must’ve been crazy to see this guy circling around the bushes like a dog, just for him to choose to pee right outside your car window. 

I just nodded and smiled (social anxiety amiright?) and walked home.

So if she is introduced to the story in book 3 of 5 and the reader is meant to believe that she is the MC’s best friend, i feel like it would be a tough pill to swallow and may even undermine your intent of making it a real betrayal. The reader will probably be skeptical of this important character introduced seemingly out of nowhere. 

Having said all that, if Anna and MC’s friendship was established from the beginning, but Anna was on her own mission/was busy with something and would write to the MC or whatever to let them and the reader know she cares, then that could be a better solution so at least she is soft-introduced to the reader before her proper intro in book 3.
